title: norite guild --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite guild list`, `create`, `show`, `update`, `delete`, `transfer`, `audit-log` and `recording-log`.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what these commands print ships with a change to this file in the same commit. The shapes are the CLI's, re-declared from the instance's rather than passed through. Every nullable field is present and null, every list is [] rather than null, and every string an instance sent is exactly as sent, with what a terminal would act on escaped as \uXXXX.

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

owner_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

recording.description: Whether the guild records every message (M16b); switched by its owner with `norite guild update --recording on|off`.

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

action.description: The audit log's verb: role.create, guild.update, message.delete, …

actor_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

target_id.description: A Snowflake ID as a decimal string, or null.

changes.description: The entry's diff exactly as the instance recorded it: a changed field is an object with from and/or to, a context field a scalar.

auditPage.description: A page of the audit log, newest first.

next.description: The id to pass to --before for the next page, or null on the last page: a page shorter than --limit.

recordingEntry.description: One entry of a recording guild's message log.

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

actor_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

channel_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

message_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

content.description: The message as it was at this moment, or null.

recordingPage.description: A page of the recording log, newest first.

next.description: The id to pass to --before for the next page, or null on the last page: a page shorter than --limit.
